newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ ends sharply firmer, prices still correcting.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ ends sharply firmer, prices still correcting.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed higher for the second consecutive session in an ongoing technical correction, market sources said.
Local short-covering and speculative buying lifted the May contract to a high of 84.75 cents, where it filled a gap on the charts left Monday.
Trade selling contributed to the day's estimated volume of 3,000 lots, floor sources said. Wednesday's official volume was 3,876 lots.
Despite some recent gains, the near-term outlook remains negative for juice futures, market sources said.
"We expect prices to stay in a trading range and ultimately work lower," an analyst said. "This is a couple of days of consolidation after a big move but the fundamentals are still negative."
Industry sources await Florida's weekly movement data, released after the close today.
May juice ended up 1.35 cents at 83.30 cents per pound, having ranged from 85.15 to 81.65 cents. The back months settled 1.40 higher to 1.10 weaker.
Support was pegged at 77.50 and then at 65.45 in May.
